summary: Object constructor with SEH and locale vtable chain setup. Registers the frame SEH handler, saves the ecx-passed this pointer (v3) to the frame, then only when the guard field at this+0xC is non-zero applies the locale base chain: *v3 = unk_5B9C5C, v3[11] = 0, v3[2] = basic_ios vftable, and sets frame completion flags. Regardless of the guard, writes the basic_istream vftable at this + *(*(this)+4), then calls sub_59A8FA on that adjusted pointer and returns this.

local_names.a1: ebp frame base; frame slots at a1-20, a1-16, a1-4 are constructor state
local_names.v3: this pointer passed in ecx (__userpurge) and returned
local_names.v5: alias of v3 used as the return value

operations.description: SEHHandlerInit() registers the frame exception handler located at loc_59D40A
v4 = (*(this + 0xC) == 0); a zero field means the locale init block is skipped, a non-zero field means it runs
Save this (v3) into frame slot a1-20 and clear frame slot a1-16 (init-in-progress flag)
When v4 is false (field 0xC non-zero), enter the conditional locale vtable-chain init block
Set the locale base vtable pointer: *v3 = unk_5B9C5C, and clear v3[11]
Set v3[2] = std::basic_ios vftable (0x005B9C50), the next level of the chain
Mark init complete: frame slot a1-16 = 1 and clear frame slot a1-4
Write std::basic_istream vftable (0x005B9C40) at this + *(*(this)+4); the slot read from the vtable is a multi-inheritance vtable-adjustment offset
sub_59A8FA(this + *(*(this)+4)) completes construction of the vtable-adjusted subobject
Return v5 (this pointer) from the constructor
